description:
The marketing website 'acmecorp.test' is experiencing 502 Bad Gateway errors due to traffic spikes. You need to optimize its PHP-FPM process manager settings. 

Navigate to the PHP-FPM Configuration for the 'acmecorp.test' virtual server (found under Services -> PHP-FPM Configuration -> Edit Configuration Manually, or similar menu path depending on the theme). 

Locate the pool configuration and set the following values exactly:
- pm = dynamic
- pm.max_children = 40
- pm.start_servers = 10
- pm.min_spare_servers = 5
- pm.max_spare_servers = 15

Save the file and ensure the settings are applied (Virtualmin usually reloads automatically, but you may need to check).
